buffer.lookup_text: MUTCD Table 6B-2: 820 ft. CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 14 posts a 650 ft minimum at 75 mph, but only as part of the Case 27 mandatory speed step-down (75 → 65 mph); this plan has no qualifying reduction, so the federal posted-speed value governs (Sheet 7 Case 11: buffer VARIES per General Note 24).
buffer.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.06, Table 6B-2 (stopping sight distance). CDOT S-630-1 Sheet 7 Case 11 (buffer VARIES per General Note 24).

spacing.downstream_count_text: Downstream taper: 50 ft at ~25 ft spacing -> 2 cones (MUTCD Sec 6B.08: 50-100 ft downstream taper); 15 tangent + 2 downstream = 17 cones total
spacing.in_taper_text: 75 mph -> 75 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals speed in feet)
spacing.on_tangent_text: 75 mph -> 150 ft spacing (MUTCD Sec 6K.01: spacing equals 2x speed in feet)
spacing.tangent_count_text: 2000 ft / 150 ft max spacing -> 15 cones at 142.9 ft intervals
spacing.taper_count_text: L/3 = 250 ft / 75 ft max spacing -> 5 drums at 62.5 ft intervals

taper.source: MUTCD 11th Ed. Sec 6B.08, Table 6B-4 (taper length L). Shoulder closures use L/3 per Sec 6B.08 (Table 6B-3).
